mapper.select: SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, A.BOOKSET_NAME booksetName, A.BOOKSET_TYPE booksetType, A.ACCT_MODE acctMode, A.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID acctSubjectId, A.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE acctSubjectType, A.STANDARD_CCY standardCcy, A.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL booksetIdTmpl, A.ACCT_STANDARD acctStandard, A.START_DATE startDate, A.END_DATE endDate, A.BOK_SPEC_MODE bokSpecMode, A.BOOKSET_FULLNAME booksetFullname, B.BOOKSET_DATE booksetDate FROM BOK_BOOKSET A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE B ON A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID WHERE A.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, A.SUBJECT_NO subjectNo, A.SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, A.FSUBJECT_ID fsubjectId, A.BAL_FLAG balFlag, A.SUBJECT_TYPE subjectType, A.SUBJECT_LEVEL subjectLevel, A.ACC_QUA_FLAG accQuaFlag, A.ACC_INT_FLAG accIntFlag, A.OVERDRAWN_FLAG overdrawnFlag, A.GEN_DETSUB_FLAG genDetsubFlag, A.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE baseSubjectNature, A.INV_AIM invAim, A.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, A.CREATE_USER createUser, A.CREATE_DEPT createDept, A.CREATE_TIME createTime, A.UPDATE_USER updateUser, A.UPDATE_TIME updateTime FROM BOK_SUBJECT A
WHERE A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, A.TABLE_ID tableId, A.TABLE_NAME tableName, A.REMARK remark, A.CREATE_USER createUser, A.CREATE_DEPT createDept, A.CREATE_TIME createTime, A.UPDATE_USER updateUser, A.UPDATE_TIME updateTime FROM BOK_TABLELIST A WHERE A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, A.DICT_ID dictId, A.DICT_CODE dictCode, A.TABLE_ID tableId, A.DICT_NAME dictName, A.DICT_TYPE dictType, A.DICT_SOURCE dictSource, A.CREATE_USER createUser, A.CREATE_DEPT createDept, A.CREATE_TIME createTime, A.UPDATE_USER updateUser, A.UPDATE_TIME updateTime FROM BOK_TABLEDICT A WHERE A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, A.SCENE_NODE_ID sceneNodeId, A.SUBJECT_NO subjectNo, A.CD_FLAG cdFlag, A.FORM_ELE formEle, A.BOK_DETAIL_ID bokDetailId, A.ACCOUNT_NET accountNet, A.CREATE_USER createUser, A.CREATE_DEPT createDept, A.CREATE_TIME createTime, A.UPDATE_USER updateUser, A.UPDATE_TIME updateTime FROM BOK_SCENESUBJECT A WHERE A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, A.SCENE_NODE_ID sceneNodeId, A.FSCENE_NODEID fsceneNodeid, A.NODE_ID nodeId, A.NODE_VALUE nodeValue, A."LEVEL" "level", A.REMARK remark, A.CREATE_USER createUser, A.CREATE_DEPT createDept, A.CREATE_TIME createTime, A.UPDATE_USER updateUser, A.UPDATE_TIME updateTime FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG A WHERE A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, A.BOOKSET_SCHEME_ID booksetSchemeId, A.SCHEME_ID schemeId, A.scheme_type schemeType, A.CREATE_USER createUser, A.CREATE_DEPT createDept, A.CREATE_TIME createTime, A.UPDATE_USER updateUser, A.UPDATE_TIME updateTime FROM BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN A WHERE A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

select VAL.BOOKSET_ID, VAL.SUBJECT_NO, VAL.SUBJECT_NAME, VAL.FSUBJECT_ID, VAL.BAL_FLAG, VAL.SUBJECT_TYPE, VAL.SUBJECT_LEVEL, VAL.ACC_QUA_FLAG, VAL.ACC_INT_FLAG, VAL.OVERDRAWN_FLAG, VAL.GEN_DETSUB_FLAG, VAL.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE, VAL.INV_AIM, VAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID from BOK_SUBJECT VAL WHERE VAL.BOOKSET_ID=#{booksetId} AND VAL.SUBJECT_NO=#{subjectNo}

SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ a.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ a.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, /**金融产品简称**/ a.FINPROD_NAME AS finprodName, /**金融产品全称**/ a.PROFIT_TYPE AS profitType, /**收益类型**/ a.COUPON_SPECIES AS couponSpecies, /**息票品种**/ a.CHL_FINPROD_ID AS chlFinprodId, /**通道代码**/ a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS finprodMarketId, /**市场代码**/ a.ISSUE_PRICE AS issuePrice, /**发行价**/ a.ISSUE_AMT AS issueAmt, /**发行规模**/ a.CCY AS ccy, /**币种**/ a.BLN_AREA AS blnArea, /**境内外**/ /**a.DEAL_CAL_ID AS dealCalId, 关联日历**/ a.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket, /**交易场所**/ a.ISSUE_TYPE AS issueType, /**发行方式**/ a.ISSUER AS issuer, /**发行人**/ a.IDATE AS idate, /**发行日**/ a.VDATE AS vdate, /**起息日**/ a.MDATE AS mdate, /**到期日**/ a.ACTMDATE AS actmdate, /**实际到期日**/ a.IS_CHL AS isChl, /**是否通道**/ a.IS_SUS AS isSus, /**是否永续**/ a.IS_RIGHT AS isRight, /**是否含权**/ a.P_FINPROD_ID AS pFinprodId, /**母金融产品代码**/ a.O_FINPROD_ID AS oFinprodId, /**原金融产品代码**/

SELECT A.FINPROD_TYPE FROM ( SELECT FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE ='F16' UNION ALL SELECT FINPROD_ID||TO_CHAR(VDATE,'yyyyMMdd') AS FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_TYPE FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE = 'F22' AND BRANCH_TYPE IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT ACCT_SUBJECT_ID,ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE='F18' ) A WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{prodId} AND ROWNUM = 1
